name: Hacker News API
tagline: Free, no-auth Firebase REST API for live Hacker News stories, comments, and users
description: Official public Hacker News API hosted on Firebase Realtime Database. Provides near real-time read-only access to stories, comments, jobs, polls, users, and ranking lists (top, new, best, Ask HN, Show HN). No authentication or signup required; responses are JSON. Documented as having no rate limit, though aggressive clients should cache and back off. Separate unofficial Algolia HN Search API exists for full-text search.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public read-only Firebase REST endpoints; append .json to paths. No API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free; no paid plans. Official docs: no rate limit (be polite; aggressive use may be blocked).

rate_limits: Official docs: "There is currently no rate limit." Community reports temporary blocks under excessive load; cache and back off recommended.

use_cases: fetch current top Hacker News story IDs
get full story or comment details by item ID
list Ask HN, Show HN, or job postings
look up a HN user profile and submitted item IDs
poll max item ID or updates feed for new activity
build a live HN reader with top/new/best rankings
